def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Full-color separator rows and columns define the compartments.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]

    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_bands = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                 for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_bands = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1])
                 for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def cells_in_band(rb, cb):
        r0, r1 = rb
        c0, c1 = cb
        return [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]

    # Each occupied compartment is paired with the vertically adjacent
    # compartment; if its partner is empty, add its vertical reflection.
    for b in range(0, len(row_bands) - 1, 2):
        top, bottom = row_bands[b], row_bands[b + 1]
        for cb in col_bands:
            upper = cells_in_band(top, cb)
            lower = cells_in_band(bottom, cb)
            up_obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in upper if grid[r][c] != 0]
            lo_obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in lower if grid[r][c] != 0]

            if up_obj and not lo_obj:
                r0, r1 = top
                for r, c, color in up_obj:
                    rr = r0 + (r1 - 1 - r)
                    out[bottom[0] + (bottom[1] - 1 - rr), c] = color
            elif lo_obj and not up_obj:
                r0, r1 = bottom
                for r, c, color in lo_obj:
                    rr = r0 + (r1 - 1 - r)
                    out[top[0] + (top[1] - 1 - rr), c] = color

    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_bands = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1)]
    col_bands = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1)]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for i in range(len(row_bands) - 1):
        top, bottom = row_bands[i], row_bands[i + 1]
        for left, right in col_bands:
            upper = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(*top) for c in range(left, right) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            lower = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(*bottom) for c in range(left, right) if grid[r][c] != 0]

            if bool(upper) == bool(lower):
                continue

            src, dst = (upper, bottom) if upper else (lower, top)
            src_start, src_end = top if upper else bottom
            dst_start, dst_end = dst

                cc = left + local_c
                if dst_start <= rr < dst_end and left <= cc < right:
                    out[rr][cc] = color

    return out
